video.title: AI欧腐《热浪交锋/Heat Wave Rivals Bound to My Stepbrother》
video.desc:
本来看到继兄弟不想看的但看了一点感觉还可以
Beach volleyball rising star Lucas enters school determined to win the captaincy and a scholarship—only to clash with the overwhelmingly talented Alex. On the court, they're bitter rivals. Then fate plays a joke: the two sworn enemies become stepbrothers in a blended family. Under one roof, tension turns into something more—Alex taunts him openly, yet his eyes always follow Lucas, his feelings unmistakable. 
沙滩排球新星 Lucas 一入学便立志拿下队长之位和奖学金，却偏偏撞上了天赋异禀的 Alex。球场上，两人针锋相对，互不相让。谁知命运开了个玩笑：这对死对头竟因父母再婚成了继兄弟。同一屋檐下，剑拔弩张的气氛渐渐变了味。Alex 嘴上处处挑衅，目光却始终追随着 Lucas，那份心意早已藏不住。
